names := ["Tanaka", "Suzuki", "Yamada", "Ito", "Kato", "Mori"]
int[][] scores := [[78, 85, 94], [88, 74, 82], [65, 90, 71], [80, 79, 85], [92, 88, 95], [70, 62, 78]]
totals := [for row := scores[] then row.sum()]
records := [for index := names.indices()[] then (names[index], totals[index])]
ordered := records.sorted(by = (totals, names), descending = (true, false))
previous := -1
nat rank := 0
for: (name, total) := ordered[position]
    if total != previous
        rank = position + 1
    previous = total
    average := real(total) / 3.0
    println("{rank}. {name} total={total} average={average:.2}")
